10223.html:
10223 músala m.n. 'pestle' AV., 'club' Mn., musra- n. lex. 2. *muṣala- or *muśala-. [s after u and in NIA. variation of ū with u point to non-Aryan origin (J. Bloch BSOS v 741 ← Drav.: see also maṣati)]
    1. Pa. musala- m.n. 'pestle', °aka- n. 'small do.', Pk. musala-, mūsala- m.; Kho. (Lor.) mvsul 'pestle, stonethumper'; Sh. (Lor.) muzvl 'stone pestle'; S. muhurī f. 'large pestle'; L. mōˋlā 'pestle', P. muhlā, mūhlā, mohlā m. (mūsal m. ← H.), WPah.bhad. bhal. khaś. musal n., Ku. N. musal, A. muhal, B. musal, Or. musaḷa; Bi. mūsar, (Shahabad) musarā 'pestle of rice-husking machine'; Mth. mūsar, musarā 'pestle', Aw.lakh. mūsarᵘ, H. musal, mūsal m., mūslī f. 'small pestle', G. musḷũ n., M. musaḷ n., Si. mohola, mōla, Md. mō. — Prob. P. mūslī f. 'taproot', N. musuro (← Bi. Mth.?), H. mūslā m.
    2. K. muhulᵘ m. 'pestle', muhüjᷴ f. 'small do.'; WPah. (Joshi) muśḷ m. 'pestle, club', muśḷī f. 'small do.', jaun. mūśṛī 'pestle'.
    Addenda: músala-. 1. Md. mō (mōlek) 'pestle'.

9198.html:
9198 *bā 'father'. 2. *bāī- 'mother'. [Cf. *bāppa-, *bābba-. — Nursery words]
    1. Pk. bāa- m. 'child'; Paš.weg. Shum. bā 'father'; N. bā 'father', bājyā 'grandfather', bājei 'grandmother'.
    2. Pk. bāiyā- f. 'mother', G. bāī f.
    *bāī- 'mother' see prec.
    bākurá- see *bōra-².

14029.html:
14029 hastatala n. 'palm of hand' Mudr. [hásta-, tala-]
    Pa. hatthatala- n. 'palm', P. hathelī, thelī f., Ku. hat(h)elī, H. hathelī f. (→ G. hathelī f.); — Si. atala, atula, alla, Md. aitala (or poss. with EGS 12 < Si. cmpd. at-tala).
    Addenda: hastatala-: WPah.kṭg. thḗl m. 'paw (e.g. of a cat)'; — in kc. hath-naḷe f. 'palm of hand' (dissim. th-t to th-n Him.I 221: + tā́ḍa-¹), kṭg. thənɔḷi f.
